field.name: Name
landing.title: Welcome to {site}
landing.lead: A simple place to write, keep and share your documents, with every version saved.
landing.f1: Create and edit Markdown and text files directly on the website, with a live preview.
landing.f2: Every change is saved as a new version. You can always look back at what changed and when.
landing.f3: Repositories are private by default. Make them public only when you are ready to share.
home.no_repos: You do not have any repositories yet. A repository is a folder for your documents that remembers every change.
explore.title: Public repositories
explore.intro: Repositories that their owners have made public.
login.title: Log in
login.intro: Log in with one of the following accounts. If you do not have an account here yet, it will be created when you log in for the first time, if registration is open to you.
login.dev_warning: This login form is for development only: it trusts any email address you type.
login.invite_ok: Your invitation is valid. Log in to create your account.
login.invite_invalid: This invitation link is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
login.registration_restricted: New accounts can only be created with an invitation or after pre-registration.
login.no_providers: No login methods are configured. Please contact the administrator.
settings.handle_help: Your user name is part of the web and Git addresses of your repositories. Changing it changes those addresses.
settings.advanced_mode_help: Shows branches: parallel versions of a repository. In simple mode you always work with the main branch only.
settings.primary_email_help: The address you log in with. It is not shown to other people.
settings.contact_email_help: Shown in your public profile and recorded as the author of changes you save in the browser. A new address must be confirmed through a link we email to it.
settings.contact_pending: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Until you open it, {current} stays your contact email.
settings.description_help: Plain text shown in your public profile. HTML tags are not allowed.
settings.homepage_help: A web address shown in your public profile, for example https://example.com.
verify.title: Confirm your contact email
verify.text: Use {email} as the contact email of the account @{handle}?
email.verify_body:
Hello {name},

please confirm that this address should be your contact email on {site} by opening this link:

{link}

The link is valid for {hours} hours. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this message.
tokens.intro: Access tokens let Git programs and other tools read or change your repositories. Use a token as the password when Git asks for one.
tokens.none: You have not created any tokens yet.
tokens.otp_help: An 8-digit password that can be exchanged for this token once, within {days} days. Useful for setting up an app without copying the long token.
tokens.otp_confirm: A new token value and one-time password will be generated. The current token value will stop working. Continue?
tokens.otp_replace_confirm: This token already has a one-time password that has not been used. It will be replaced by a new one. Continue?
tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Programs using it will lose access.
tokens.copy_now: Copy the token now. For your security it is not stored and will not be shown again.
tokens.otp_explain: Enter this password in the app that asks for it. It works only once, until {date}.
tokens.usage_git: Use the token as the password when Git asks for one, or include it in the address:
tokens.usage_password: Replace TOKEN with the value above. The user name can be anything.
tokens.usage_simple: Enter the token as the password when Git or your app asks for one.
repo.private_help: Only you can see and download it.
repo.public_help: Anyone on the internet can see, read and download all files and their complete history, without logging in. Only you can make changes.
repo.public_warning: Do not make a repository public if it contains anything personal or confidential, including in older versions of files.
repo.name: Repository name
repo.name_help: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. The name is part of the repository address.
repo.clone_help_public: Anyone can download this repository with Git. To make changes, use an access token as the password.
repo.clone_help_private: Use an access token as the password.
repo.empty_owner: Create a new file or upload files to get started.
repo.empty_push: Or upload an existing Git repository
repo.binary_file: This file cannot be displayed ({size} bytes). Use the Raw button to download it.
repo.delete_file_confirm: Delete {name}? The file remains available in the history.
repo.rename_help: Change the name to rename or move the file. Use / to put it into a folder.
repo.diff_too_large: The file is too large to show the changes.
repo.diff_skipped: Too many changed files; changes not shown.
repo.tags_intro: A tag is a name for a specific version, such as a finished draft or a release, so you can find it again later.
repo.tag_message_placeholder: For example: final version sent to the editor
repo.tag_delete_confirm: Delete tag {name}? The files are not affected.
repo.branches_intro: Branches are parallel versions of the repository. Changes in one branch do not affect the others.
repo.branch_delete_confirm: Delete branch {name}? Changes that exist only in this branch will be lost.
repo.rename_repo_help: Renaming changes the web and Git addresses of the repository.
repo.delete_help: This permanently deletes the repository with all files and history. This cannot be undone. Type the repository name to confirm.
admin.delete_confirm: Permanently delete {email} with all their repositories and tokens?
admin.invitations_disabled: Registration by invitation is disabled in the server configuration; invitation links will not work.
admin.invite_created: Invitation created. Send this link to the person you are inviting; it is shown only once:
admin.prereg_disabled: Pre-registration is disabled in the server configuration.
admin.prereg_intro: People with these email addresses may create an account. The entry is removed when they register.
admin.custom_css_help: Added to every page after the built-in styles.
admin.no_logo: No logo uploaded; the default icon is used.
admin.logo_help: PNG, JPEG, SVG, WebP or GIF, up to {kb} KB.
flash.verification_sent: Settings saved. We sent a confirmation link to your new contact email.
flash.contact_change_cancelled: The contact email was not changed.
error.title: Error
error.not_found: This page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.
error.internal: An internal error occurred. Please try again later.
error.csrf: This form has expired. Go back, reload the page and try again.
error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
error.account_blocked: Your account has been blocked. Please contact the administrator.
error.registration_not_allowed: Registration is not open for this email address. You need an invitation or pre-registration.
error.advanced_mode_required: This requires advanced mode, which you can turn on in your settings.
error.branch_exists: A branch with this name already exists.
error.cannot_delete_main: The main branch cannot be deleted.
error.edit_conflict: The file was changed by someone else (or in another window) while you were editing. Your text is kept below; saving again will replace the latest version with it.
error.file_exists: A file with this name already exists.
error.handle_taken: This user name is already taken.
error.invalid_handle: User names may contain lowercase letters, digits and dashes (2 to 39 characters), and some names are reserved.
error.invalid_path: Invalid file name. Do not use names like . or .. or .git.
error.invalid_repo_name: Invalid repository name. Use letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, and do not end the name with .git.
error.logo_too_large: The logo file is too large.
error.not_a_branch: Files can only be changed on a branch, not on a tag or an old version.
error.not_editable: This file cannot be edited in the browser.
error.path_conflict: A file and a folder cannot have the same name.
error.repo_exists: You already have a repository with this name.
error.tag_exists: A tag with this name already exists.
error.token_name_required: Please give the token a name.
error.no_files: Please choose at least one file.
error.confirm_mismatch: The name you typed does not match the repository name.
error.invalid_homepage: Invalid homepage. Enter a web address such as https://example.com.
error.description_too_long: The text about you is too long (at most 1000 characters).
error.description_html: The text about you must not contain HTML tags.
error.verification_too_soon: A confirmation link was sent less than a minute ago. Please wait a moment before requesting another one.
error.verification_invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. You can request a new one in your settings.
error.no_pending_email: There is no contact email waiting for confirmation.
error.mail_failed: The confirmation email could not be sent. Please try again later.
